page_title: BOL 4-0 PIS | Bologna v Pisa 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' That's it for today, Rosario Abisso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Rosario Abisso interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
88' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
87' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
85' CHANCE! Nadir Zortea finds Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!

83' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Adrian Semper shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
83' 71:29 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
79' The Bologna players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
77' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris comes off the pitch to be replaced by Arturo Calabresi (Pisa).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Louis Buffon (Pisa) comes onto the pitch for M'Bala Nzola.
77' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
75' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Thijs Dallinga will be replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) is replacing Nikola Moro.
71' The referee has issued a yellow card to Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
70' 7:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
69' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
68' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) sends an accurate pass to Juan Miranda, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
67' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Fine attempt! Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
65' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) is brought on as a substitute for Isak Vural.
61' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' A pass by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
59' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) is penalised for holding. Rosario Abisso signals a set piece.
56' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replacing Jens Odgaard.
56' It is time for a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian is on for Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
56' Nicolo Cambiaghi will be replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna).
55' A long pass finds Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
55' Nikola Moro (Bologna) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
53' 4 - 0 Goal! Thijs Dallinga passes the ball to Jens Odgaard (Bologna) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Adrian Semper couldn't do anything about it. 4:0.
53' Some patient build-up play from Bologna as they look to unlock the defence.
51' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.

49' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
48' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Matteo Tramoni is replaced by Samuele Angori (Pisa).
46' Alberto Gilardino makes a half-time substitution. Henrik Meister (Pisa) comes on in place of Giovanni Bonfanti.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Federico Bernardeschi has come on in place of Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
46' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' A cross into the box from Nadir Zortea (Bologna) is cleared.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' What a chance that is! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
44' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

44' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Bologna are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
42' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.

40' 3 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Nicolo Cambiaghi, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), who beats Adrian Semper with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:0.

38' 2 - 0 Goal! Nikola Moro (Bologna) takes the resulting free-kick from the edge of the box, but the ball takes a deflection off a defender and goes past the helpless Adrian Semper and into the net. 2:0.
37' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
35' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Adrian Semper has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
34' Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
34' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
33' It looks like Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) saw red with that tackle. Rosario Abisso won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
32' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
30' The linesman signals that Juan Miranda (Bologna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
29' Some great controlled play and passing from Bologna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.
26' Pisa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' 1 - 0 GOAL! Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the right-hand post. The score is 1:0.

23' What a poor attempt! Jens Odgaard (Bologna) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
23' The ball is cleared after Nadir Zortea (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Rosario Abisso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marius Marin (Pisa).
22' The resulting corner from Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
19' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) latches onto the free kick from Matteo Tramoni, but heads just over the bar from close range.
18' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jens Odgaard (Bologna) brought his opponent down.
18' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. It's a throw-in for Pisa.
17' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Juan Miranda, but sends his close-range header way wide of the right post.

16' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Giovanni Bonfanti was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
15' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
13' Pisa couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
12' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Rosario Abisso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
12' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
11' Juan Miranda (Bologna) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
10' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) makes a strong challenge and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul. Bologna are awarded a free kick.
9' A pass by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
7' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) dribbles into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
6' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Adrian Semper comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Remo Freuler (Bologna) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
3' Bologna are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso will referee today's match.
